module: File import utilities for Road Architect, designed for headless use (tech/BeamNGpy bridge). They read a file from a virtual or native path, copy it if needed into /temp/roadArchitectImport, prepare the editor APIs (history, preferences) without opening the UI, then finalize the roads (DecalRoads, collisions, navgraph).
usage:
local imp = extensions.editor_roadArchitect_importFile
local chemin, stage = imp.stageText('C:/x/route.json', contenu)
local data = imp.readTextFile(chemin)
imp.ensureEditorHistory()
imp.maybeFinalise({finalize = true})
notes: readTextFile tries in order: readFile with normalized separators, readFile with the raw path, FS:native2Virtual conversion, then io.open in binary mode.
stageText copies nothing if fileContent is nil or empty: it then returns the original path and false.
maybeFinalise returns false, nil when options.finalize is not exactly true, doing nothing.
ensureEditorHistory raises an error (error) if editor_main, editor.history or editor.getPreference remain unavailable.

readTextFile.desc: Reads the content of a file from an absolute virtual or native path. Tries readFile, the native-to-virtual conversion, then io.open in binary. Returns nil if the path is invalid or the file is not found.

filePath.desc: Virtual or native path (backslashes are normalized to /).

stageText.desc: Writes the given content to /temp/roadArchitectImport/<file name> (folder created if needed) so that the game can read it in its virtual file system. Converts fileContent to a string with tostring if it is not one. Raises an error if the write fails.

filePath.desc: Original path, of which only the file name is kept (import.bin by default).

fileContent.desc: Content to write; if nil or empty, nothing is written.

returns.desc: Usable path: the staged file, or filePath if nothing was written.
true if the file was staged.

ensureEditorHistory.desc: Prepares the World Editor APIs needed for import and finalization without opening the UI: loads editor_main if needed, calls editor.initializeModules to create the history, then editor.ensurePreferencesApi or editor.loadPreferences for the preferences (needed by roadRiver.getPreference when finalizing DecalRoads).
notes: Needed because setEditorActive is deferred over several splash frames and cannot be used within a single BeamNGpy request.

maybeFinalise.desc: If options.finalize is true, places the DecalRoads and meshes, reloads collisions and rebuilds the navgraph, like the Render/finalise toggle of Road Architect. Already finalized ("Road Architect" object exists): first calls roads.unfinalise() to avoid duplicates.

options.desc: Import options; only the finalize field (boolean) is read.

returns.desc: Error message, for example "finalize requires a loaded level (MissionGroup missing)".
